易中海和宋主任在禁闭室看见了贾东旭，这个惨呀！脸肿了，眼眶黑了，两个鼻子都在流血，浑身上下青一块紫一块。易中海虽然看着心疼，但是人在屋檐下不得不低头，况且还是贾东旭理亏。

贾东旭看见易中海，那委屈的模样就像是一个被强行呼哈了的小媳妇，抽噎的叫着师傅。易中海和宋主任七手八脚的给贾东旭松绑，然后搀着他出了禁闭室。王野看见贾东旭的样子，转头看了一眼孙叔，孙叔轻轻的摇了一下头，贾东旭三人离开了保卫科，王野等人也各自回了办公室。

一进办公室王野就问孙叔：“孙叔，那个贾东旭真没问题吗？我看着挺惨的。”

“放心吧！全是皮外伤，不伤筋动骨，也就看着惨点儿，不影响他上班。”

就在众人聊天时，轧钢厂大喇叭里响起：“鉴于钳工车间贾东旭同志随地大小便，殴打保卫科人员，现经厂领导决定，给予贾东旭同志通报批评一次，清扫厕所一个月。鉴于......”一连三次通报。

石磊幸灾乐祸的挑了挑眉：“活该！让他那么嚣张。”

到了中午，王野去了第三食堂，昨天就放了何雨柱的鸽子了，今天可不能再放了。王野进入食堂，就看见何雨柱在打饭窗口跟自己打招呼，王野也没有直接过去，而是在那个窗口排起队来。

没一会儿就轮到王野了，王野给了钱和粮票，又把饭盒递过去。何雨柱没有像别人一样直接往饭盒里盛饭，而是接过了王野的饭盒，把菜打的满满的，递给王野，还说了一句：“王野兄弟你先吃着，一会儿我去找你。”

王野猜到应该是贾东旭的事儿，只是不知道是好事儿还是坏事儿。

王野找了个没人的地方坐下就开吃，没一会儿何雨柱就来了，王野抬头，明知故问：“柱子哥，啥事儿呀？”

何雨柱挤眉弄眼：“王野兄弟，听说你把贾东旭那孙子打了？”

王野一听这话就知道不是坏事儿。

王野无所谓的说：“那孙子随地小便，还伸手打人，那我能惯着他？”

何雨柱无比赞同：“那孙子确实欠揍，一天天跟谁欠他钱似的。”

王野：“兄弟是初来乍到，也没想出头拔份儿，但咱也不是忍气吞声的娘们儿呀！”

何雨柱：“兄弟说的没毛病，但是吧，这贾东旭也有点儿麻烦。”

“怎么着，这贾东旭有什么后台吗？”

“他哪有什么后台呀！在厂里他就指着他师傅，也就是我们院的一大爷，你家我王叔也是6级工，半斤八两谁也不怕谁，麻烦的是贾东旭他娘。你们家虽说和我们院离得近，但也就只是可能听说过，那贾张氏可不是个省油的灯，一哭二闹三上吊撒泼打滚，是真让人心烦，打又打不得，骂又骂不过，她是这膈应人呀！”

王野知道了何雨柱这是来给自己报信的，好让自己心理准备。王野一边听着一边把饭也吃完了，拿出一包大前门，打开递给何雨柱一根，自己点了一根，然后就把烟盒扔在餐桌上了说：“柱子哥谢了，我心里有数，放心吧！兄弟吃不了亏。”说完也不等何雨柱回话起身就要走。

何雨柱赶紧拿起烟叫道：“王野兄弟，你的烟。”

Yi Zhonghai and Director Song saw Jia Dongxu in the solitary room. How miserable!His face was swollen, his eye sockets were black, both noses were bleeding, and he was covered in bruises and bruises.Although Yi Zhonghai looked distressed, he had to bow his head under the eaves, and it was Jia Dongxu who was in the wrong.

When Jia Dongxu saw Yi Zhonghai, he looked aggrieved like a little daughter-in-law who had been forcibly screamed, sobbing and calling for master.Yi Zhonghai and Director Song worked hard to untie Jia Dongxu, and then helped him out of the confinement room.Wang Ye saw Jia Dongxu's appearance and turned to look at Uncle Sun. Uncle Sun shook his head gently. Jia Dongxu and the others left the security department, and Wang Ye and others returned to their offices.

As soon as he entered the office, Wang Ye asked Uncle Sun: "Uncle Sun, is that Jia Dongxu really okay? I think it's quite miserable."

"Don't worry! They're all skin injuries, no injuries to his muscles and bones. They just look miserable and won't affect his work."

While everyone was chatting, the loudspeaker of the steel rolling mill sounded: "In view of the fact that Comrade Jia Dongxu defecated in the fitter workshop and beat the security department personnel, the factory leaders have decided to give Comrade Jia Dongxu a notice of criticism and a month of cleaning the toilet. In view of..." Three consecutive notices.

Shi Lei raised his eyebrows in gloating: "You deserve it! He was so arrogant."

At noon, Wang Ye went to the third canteen. He Yuzhu's pigeons were released yesterday, but they could not be released again today.When Wang Ye entered the cafeteria, he saw He Yuzhu greeting him at the meal window. Wang Ye did not go directly, but lined up at the window.

Soon it was Wang Ye's turn. Wang Ye gave money and food stamps, and handed over the lunch box.He Yuzhu did not put the rice directly into the lunch box like others, but took Wang Ye's lunch box, filled it with vegetables, handed it to Wang Ye, and said: "Brother Wang Ye, eat first, I will go find you later."

Wang Ye guessed that it was Jia Dongxu's fault, but he didn't know whether it was a good thing or a bad thing.

Wang Ye found a deserted place and sat down to eat. Soon He Yuzhu came. Wang Ye raised his head and asked, knowingly: "Brother Zhu Zhu, what's going on?"

He Yuzhu winked: "Brother Wang Ye, I heard that you beat Jia Dongxu's grandson?"

Wang Ye knew it was not a bad thing as soon as he heard this.

Wang Ye said nonchalantly: "The grandson urinates everywhere and even reaches out to hit people. How can I pamper him?"

He Yuzhu couldn't agree more: "That grandson really deserves a beating. He acts like someone who owes him money every day."

Wang Ye: "Brother, I'm new here, and I don't want to stand out, but we're not bitches who swallow our anger!"

He Yuzhu: "There's nothing wrong with what my brother said, but, Jia Dongxu is also a bit troublesome."

"What's the matter, does Jia Dongxu have any background?"

"How can he have any backing? In the factory, he pointed at his master, who is the first master of our hospital. My uncle Wang in your family is also a level 6 worker. He is not afraid of anyone. The trouble is Jia Dongxu's mother. Although your family is like me.Our hospital is close, but you may have heard that Mrs. Jia Zhang is not a light-hearted person. She cries, makes fuss, hangs herself, and rolls around. It’s really annoying. She can’t be beaten and scolded.She is such a diabolical person!”

Wang Ye knew that He Yuzhu was here to report the news to him, so that he could prepare himself mentally.Wang Ye finished his meal while listening. He took out a pack of big qianmen, opened it and handed one to He Yuzhu, lit one himself, then threw the cigarette case on the dining table and said, "Thank you, Brother Zhuzhu. I know it, don't worry! Brothers will not suffer." After saying that, he stood up and left without waiting for He Yuzhu's reply.

He Yuzhu quickly picked up the cigarette and shouted: "Brother Wang Ye, your cigarette."
